title: Robustness and Confounders in the Demographic Alignment of LLMs with Human Perceptions of Offensiveness

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing Pearson correlations between LLM-generated offensiveness labels and aggregated ground-truth annotations from specific racial and ethnic annotator groups (Asian, Black, Hispanic, White) to measure alignment.
Comparing Pearson correlations between LLM-generated offensiveness labels and aggregated ground-truth annotations from specific gender annotator groups (Men, Women) to measure alignment.
